about.text: Chhurpi, otherwise known as durkha and chogo/chugo, is a traditional cheese consumed in Nepal, Bhutan, Tibet and parts of Northeastern India. The two varieties of chhurpi are a soft variety and a very hard variety. Chhurpi is considered one of the hardest cheeses in the world.

how.text: Soft chhurpi is pressed, cut and hung over the fire until it is among the hardest cheeses in the world. No durations are given in the sources.
